question: What is the standard weight of a hockey ball?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**163 gm - 156 gm**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Field **hockey balls** are a vital part of the game of field hockey.
 
• One only needs **one ball per game.**
 
• The Hockey Rules Board of the International Hockey Federation (FIH) stipulates that field hockey balls should have a** circumference of between 224 mm and 235** mm, and **weigh between 156 grams and 163 grams. **__
 
• Hockey balls diameter of 2**.81 - 2.94 (71.3 -74.8mm )**
 
• In inches, balls must weigh between **5 1/2 ounces and 5 3/4 ounces, with a circumference of 8 13/16 inches to 9 1/4 inches.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 
 
Game

 
 
 
Circumference of the ball

 
 
 

 
 
Hockey

 
 
 
 
• Field Hockey Balls have a diameter of 2.81”-2.94” (71.3-74.8 mm) and a circumference of 8.82”-9.25” (22.4-23.5 cm).
 
• The mass of a Field Hockey Ball is between 5.5-5.7 oz (156-163 g).
 
 
 
 

 
 
Softball (Women)

 
 
 
The ball itself is typically 11 or 12 inches (28 or 30 cm) in circumference, also depending on specifics of the competition.

 
 
 

 
 
Tennis

 
 
 
 
• Tennis Balls have a diameter of 2.575”-2.7” (6.54-6.86 cm) and a circumference of 8.66”-9.02” (22-22.9 cm).
 
• The mass of a Tennis Ball must be between 1.975-2.095 oz (56-59.4 g).
